answer: A sybil tax makes bulk forgery unprofitable. Each new identity pays a 60 credit genesis tax. The tax is non-refundable. It decays 5 credits per honest epoch. It reaches zero after 12 epochs. The atlas of past taxes is public. Attackers cannot hide the cost. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 credits upfront. Capital cannot be recycled. A burned tax never returns. The oasis an attacker seeks does not exist. Honest users pay once. They earn it back in 10 epochs. The fable of cheap clones ends here. Detection forfeits the tax. It also freezes rewards for 6 epochs.
